title: Jazzy Tunisian Tofu Salad
description: A funky, bouncy-qq, indulgent Tunisian tofu salad brimming with fresh greens, citrus, and a zesty lime-harissa dressing—jain friendly and perfect for a quick lunch.
instructions: Press the tofu for 15 minutes to remove excess moisture.
Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and sear tofu slices for 3 minutes on each side until golden.
In a large bowl, combine cucumber, bell pepper, tomato, olives, and capers.
Add the seared tofu to the bowl and drizzle with the remaining olive oil, lime juice, and harissa paste.
Season with sea salt and black pepper to taste.
Toss gently to coat all ingredients evenly.
Serve immediately or chill for 10 minutes to let flavors meld.
Garnish with a sprinkle of fresh herbs if desired.
Enjoy this lively, jain-friendly salad as a satisfying lunch.
Remember to discard any leftover if not consumed within two hours.
